svg.title: Zebra danio tank size chart: how many zebra danios fit in 20, 29, 40 and 55 gallon tanks
svg.desc: Four aquarium outlines increasing in length, each showing the recommended number of zebra danios; a 20-gallon long covers ten fish and each extra danio needs about two gallons.
svg.text: Zebra danio tank size: how many danios per tank?
Planning rule: a 20-gallon long covers a school of up to 10, then about 2 US gallons per extra danio. Length matters more than height.
10 gallons (20 in) is too short for a school of 6. Upper counts need strong filtration and weekly water changes. fishcareai.com
